strategies.SC2: Select Sector SPDR top-2 by 252-day total return from prior close, equal weight, monthly, 100% invested (core/forward_tournament_v3.sc2_target)
strategies.SC2VT20: SC2 with vol target 20% on backfilled unscaled-SC2 prior 126 days, cap 1.0, remainder BIL (0% USD cash before BIL)
strategies.BL30: SPY 70% + SC2VT20 30%, reset at start and each January (spy-sector-blend-v1 PART E)
strategies.BL50: SPY 50% + SC2VT20 50%, reset at start and each January
